user.title: Waste Collection
user.description: Choose the calendar where you entered the collections (usually `calendar.raccolta_rifiuti`). Telegram notifications are enabled afterwards, from Configure.

data.name: Sensor name (optional)
data.lookahead_days: Days to look ahead for the next collection

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the automatic name.
data_description.lookahead_days: If nothing is scheduled today, the sensor looks for the next collection within this many days.
data_description.language: Language of the waste names shown by the sensor. Automatic follows Home Assistant's language.

abort.already_configured: A sensor already exists for this calendar.

data.lookahead_days: Days to look ahead for the next collection

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the automatic name.
data_description.lookahead_days: If nothing is scheduled today, the sensor looks for the next collection within this many days.
data_description.language: Language of the waste names shown by the sensor. Automatic follows Home Assistant's language.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.description: Every evening you get a Telegram message with the waste to put out. It is only sent if a collection is scheduled. Requires Home Assistant's Telegram bot integration with at least one allowed chat.

data_description.telegram_targets: The Telegram chats the message is sent to.
data_description.notify_second_time: Only used if the second notification is enabled.
data_description.notify_title: Leave empty for the automatic title. If your bot uses Markdown, avoid the characters . ! - ( ) in the title.

error.invalid_target: Select only chats from the Telegram bot integration.
error.same_time: The second notification must have a different time from the first.

abort.telegram_not_available: No Telegram chat found. First set up Home Assistant's Telegram bot integration and add a chat to the allowed ones.

deprecated_yaml.title: Raccolta Rifiuti YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: The sensor was imported automatically and is now managed from Settings > Devices & services > Waste Collection, where you can also enable Telegram notifications. Remove the `platform: raccolta_rifiuti` entry from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.
